fields.Registrierungsstelle: Kiwa-Ecobility Experts, Kiwa GmbH (Berlin)
fields.Szenariobeschreibung: There is no energy needed for the storage in a silo (no heating, no cooling, no aeration). Energy is only needed for the opening and closing of the silo. The distance between silo and factory gate is 500 m. The average energy consumption data from 2022 at the Datteln 4 power plant is utilized for EFA-Füller®, as the manufacturing of EFA-Füller® at the Datteln 4 power plant is the most energy-intensive, representing the worst-case scenario. An electricity dataset from hard coal is employed to depict the electricity supply at the power plant. No CO2 certificates were considered. Excluded are the manufacturing of capital equipment, construction undertakings, and infrastructure development, along with the maintenance and operation of capital equipment. Additionally, activities related to personnel, as well as energy and water consumption associated with company management and sales, are also excluded.
